radiusSource: Radius 97.3 +/- 2.3 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, VZ Pup: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 97.3 +/- 2.3 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 67,691,610 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
